messages.content: Our basement floor drain backed up after the heavy rain and there's sewage everywhere. We have HomeShield Essential. Is that covered?

I'm sorry you're dealing with this.
Claim status: Not reported yet. Sewer and drain backup requires water backup coverage, which HomeShield Essential only has if the $6/month water backup endorsement was added. We'll check your declarations page for it when the claim is opened.
Next step: Please still file the first notice of loss in Granite Mobile or on the Claims Line at 555-0186 so an adjuster can confirm the cause, and take photos before cleanup. Avoid direct contact with the water.
Who will contact you: A property adjuster will reach out within 48 hours with a coverage decision.
Hail dented the whole hood and roof of my car yesterday. Is that collision or comprehensive? How do I get it looked at?

Claim status: Hail damage falls under comprehensive coverage, so your comprehensive deductible applies.
Next step: Report the claim in Granite Mobile, then either use PhotoEstimate (8 photos: 4 corners, 2 damage close-ups, VIN plate, odometer; the estimate posts within 2 business days) or drive in to a Drive-In Claim Center in Cedar Bluff, Ridgeview or Lowell Flats, Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. MT, no appointment needed.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours of the report.
My car was stolen from my apartment lot overnight. I already called the police. What do I need for the claim?

I'm sorry this happened.
Claim status: Not reported yet. Theft claims need the police report number at first notice of loss, so you're ready to file.
Next step: Report the theft in Granite Mobile (Claims > Report a Claim) or on the 24/7 Claims Line at 555-0186 with the police report number, where both sets of keys are, and any items left in the car. If the vehicle isn't recovered within 14 days, it's settled as a total loss.
Who will contact you: Your auto adjuster will call within 24 hours of the report.
